title: PATRON SHRINE PLAQUES
description: Rebuilt villages now add shrine plaques for players who fund restoration bundles, placing their names beside repaired wells, new bridges, and suspiciously tasteful premium lanterns.
consequence: The village learns to say thank you in precious metals.

title: EARNED WEAPON NAMES
description: Legendary tools and weapons now gain names from the journey that shaped them, using boss scars, harvest records, and expedition history instead of paid inscription slots.
consequence: The blade gets a reason instead of a receipt.

title: DESTINY TITLE PASS
description: Season passes now include ornate prophecy titles, dramatic card-back crests, and staged NPC recognition for players who choose a paid destiny track before the story earns it.

title: STANDARD HERO CEREMONY
description: Major milestones now use one universal celebration template, with auto-filled speeches, matching ribbon colors, and a commemorative stamp for every kind of achievement.
